case.question: I fish for salmon from a boat. For this week, how good do you expect boat fishing for salmon to be at each of St. Joseph, South Haven, Grand Haven and Muskegon? Rate each port 0-4 (0 slow, 1 below average, 2 average, 3 good, 4 excellent) and say which you'd go to.

## 2025-05-07 · Grand Haven · https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3df50cf
   surface water that week (buoy 45029): avg 46 F, +3 F over the week
- coho / pier; lures shrimp, minnows; quality 1 (below average)
  evidence: "Pier fishing remained relatively slow with a few coho salmon being caught. … Fish were caught on shrimp and minnows successfully."

## Recommendation

- **Go to Grand Haven by boat.** My expected boat rating is 3 (good). South Haven is a close second, also about 3.
- **Troll 30-50 ft down or into the 50-70 ft band** off Grand Haven, with spikes, wigglers, minnows, meat rigs or spoons in black/white, green or orange.
- **Expect less at Muskegon (about 2) and St. Joseph (about 1).** I'd skip St. Joseph for boats this week.

These are my estimates from the latest reports, not DNR ratings.

## Why

- **Grand Haven and South Haven are the only ports where boats were rated good in the latest report.** The May 7 reports rated boats 3 at both.
- **Grand Haven's report gives the most specific plan.** Chinook were 30-40 ft down in 50-70 ft of water on spikes, wigglers, minnows, meat rigs and spoons (Grand Haven, 2026-05-07 report, dated 2025-05-07 in this database).
- **St. Joseph has slowed for boats.** Its boat fishing was rated below average and fish were out past 100 ft (St. Joseph, 2025-05-07).
- **I'd expect Muskegon to be middling.** Its latest report said "a fair number" of Chinook were caught, but didn't say whether they came from boats or shore (Muskegon, 2025-05-07).

## Evidence

**Recent reports (latest is May 7, six days old)**
- **Grand Haven, boat:** Chinook rated 3 (good). Fish were in 40-75 ft of water, 30-40 ft down, on spikes, wigglers, minnows, meat rigs and spoons, with black/white, greens and oranges best. Boats also found king salmon in 65-75 ft going south toward Port Sheldon (Grand Haven, 2025-05-07).
- **South Haven, boat:** Coho and Chinook rated 3 (good). Boats caught fish from 15 to about 80 ft on spoons and small crankbaits (South Haven, 2025-05-07). The April 30 report also rated boats 3 at 45-60 ft (South Haven, 2025-04-30).
- **Muskegon:** Chinook rated 2 (average), with the method not stated (Muskegon, 2025-05-07). The April 30 Muskegon boat report was "hit or miss" and rated 1 (Muskegon, 2025-04-30).
- **St. Joseph, boat:** Rated 1 (below average). Boat anglers said fishing had slowed. They were fishing 45 ft out past 100 ft of water, on small flashers, flies and spoons (St. Joseph, 2025-05-07).

**Past seasons (history, not current)**
- In similar water temperatures in past Mays, boats often did well on spoons in roughly 30-80 ft. A May 2023 Grand Haven report with a sharp water drop had salmon at 35-80 ft down on green and orange spoons, rated 3 (Grand Haven, 2023-05-17).

**Conditions now (buoy, measured; backtest summary for the week before May 13)**
- Grand Haven and Muskegon buoys (45029): average 46 F, flat over the week.
- South Haven buoy (45168): average 46 F, up 4 F over the week.
- St. Joseph buoy (45026): average 51 F, up 3 F over the week.
- No modeled cold-layer depth or wind forecast was available in this backtest, so I can't tell you the water temperature at fishing depth or whether wind will push it out.

## Caveats

- **The newest report is May 7, six days old.** Spring conditions can shift fast, so treat these ratings as a starting point and check the next DNR bulletin.
- **Current water data is only the buoy, miles offshore.** It is measured, but I have no modeled water temperature at fishing depth or wind forecast for this week.
- **Ratings are my estimates from a few reports.** Muskegon's boat method is unclear, and the South Haven and Grand Haven figures come from single reports.

## Sources

- Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven and St. Joseph DNR bulletin, 2025-05-07: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3df50cf
- South Haven and St. Joseph DNR bulletin, 2025-04-30: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3de4822
- Grand Haven and Muskegon DNR bulletin, 2023-05-17 (history): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/35b2589
